## WildSpark 2.2.40

- Add WildMaps as an integrated module with its own settings-pane icon tab, enable switch, and World Map button.
- Add HiddenMaps 1.2.2 dungeon/approach map registrations, floor and wing controls, boss/entrance markers, and credited Forever map artwork.
- Show client-reported room/subzone text where available. Player location remains approximate and best-effort; most dungeon interiors are static maps.
- Preserve upstream attribution, asset notices, artwork credits, and watermarks.
